description: Transplant the selected n2048 active-rank scalar reflector-pull specialization onto the accepted integrated six-size candidate: rank 0 must read normalized reflectors in place and remote ranks must copy only when they own 8-lane A*v row groups; preserve the integrated n512 direct triplet/tail fold, n1024 two-CTA reducer and strict repairs, exact per-size launch bounds, compact GPU-wide [W,V,W] updates, certificates, fallbacks, stress routing and CUDA guards, then bracket the n2048 target with exact repeats and profile the final integrated SHA.

Across three exact runs the integrated candidate spans 30519.596-30547.315 us overall and 83997.653-84074.186 us at n2048.

Selected clean SHA 95b768e531399a059813e14d019621a3cb59b58a. The minimal combine transplanted the n2048 active-rank scalar reflector policy onto the accepted six-size candidate without changing n512/n1024 logic or exact launch bounds: rank 0 reads in place and a remote rank copies only when it owns an 8-lane A*v row group. Build passed and validation was 39/39. Three exact full-suite runs measured 30547.314870, 30519.596267, and 30531.873392 us (best 30519.596267; range 27.719 us); n2048 measured 84074.186, 83997.653, and 84023.888 us. Final profiles for n32/n176/n352/n512/n1024/n2048 are keyed to the selected SHA. The n2048 reducer profile is 116.229639 ms over 372 launches, versus 116.537548 ms for the integrated parent and 116.231700 ms for the isolated specialization. No leaderboard submission was made. Concrete follow-ups on this integrated SHA include rechecking the active-only barrier and aligned/vector remote-copy variants under the integrated launch bounds, sweeping the size cutoff around 128, and testing overlap of the remote shared-memory fill with projection setup while preserving the rank-ownership predicate.
